twoFactor.off: Off. Turn it on to be asked for a code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, Aegis or 1Password) as well as your password when you log in.

twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.orType: Or enter this key in it:

twoFactor.backupCodesIntro_other: Keep these {{count}} backup codes somewhere safe. Each logs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. You won't see them again.

requests.title: Sign-up requests
requests.help: Accounts waiting for approval. They can log in, but can't see or do anything else until approved. Declining deletes the account.

testers.help: People asking on voicaw.com to join the Android app's closed test on Google Play. Add their emails to the test's tester list in the Play Console, then mark them added. Delete a request once you're done with it.

invites.title: Invites
invites.help: Links that let someone sign up when sign-ups are invite only, or skip the wait for approval. New links are copied straight away.

voiceRegions.title: Voice regions
voiceRegions.help: The LiveKit servers voice can go through, each with a flag and a name. Calls, and voice channels left on Automatic, use the default; a guild can put a voice channel in any of them (its settings), closer to its people. Each server sends its webhooks to this API's /api/livekit/webhook and needs its own API key.
voiceRegions.notSetUp: Not set up (no LiveKit in server/.env)
voiceRegions.confirmRemove: Remove it? Its voice channels go back to Automatic, and anyone in them moves.
voiceRegions.name: Name
voiceRegions.builtinHelp: This server's own LiveKit: its address and keys are in server/.env.

storage.title: Storage
storage.help: How full the object store (MinIO) is, where attachments, pictures and emoji are kept. Its free space is its drive's, so anything else on that drive counts too.
storage.unavailable: The object store doesn't say how much space it has: only MinIO reports it, and it couldn't be reached or isn't MinIO.
storage.lag: MinIO counts each bucket every few minutes and rereads the drive about once a minute, so these can be a little behind.

content.title: Content
content.blurNsfwHint: Images, videos, GIFs and embeds in guild channels marked NSFW are blurred until you click them. Turn this off to see them straight away. Anything sent as a spoiler stays blurred either way. Saved to your account, for all your devices.
content.adultHint: NSFW channels only open once you've ticked this. Only your answer is kept with your account, never your date of birth.
content.botDmsHint: Bots in your guilds can send you direct messages (reminders, game turns…), and you can message them. These aren't end-to-end encrypted: the bot's maker and Voicaw's server can read them. Turned off, no bot can start or continue a conversation with you.

dateTime.hint: Messages will show: {{example}}. Automatic follows your browser's language (British English if it has none). Saved on this device.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.intro: Deletes your account for good. Your messages stay, shown as from “Deleted User”.
deleteAccount.warning: This can’t be undone. Once your account is deleted:
deleteAccount.loggedOut: You’re logged out everywhere and can’t log in again. Your username becomes free for anyone.
deleteAccount.messagesStay: Your messages in chats, groups and guilds stay, shown as from “Deleted User”. Your notes are deleted.
deleteAccount.leaveEverything: You leave every guild and group DM. People you talked to can still read your conversations, but not reply.
deleteAccount.ownGuilds_one: You own a guild. Make someone else the owner (Make owner on their card in the member list), or delete it:
deleteAccount.ownGuilds_other: You own {{count}} guilds. Make someone else the owner (Make owner on their card in the member list), or delete them:
deleteAccount.deleteGuilds_one: Delete this guild and everything in it too
deleteAccount.deleteGuilds_other: Delete these {{count}} guilds and everything in them too

desktopApp.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
desktopApp.closeToTrayHint: So notifications and calls still reach you. Quit from the tray icon's menu.
desktopApp.startAtLogin: Start Voicaw when you log in to your computer
desktopApp.shortcutsHint: These work even when another app is in front.
desktopApp.shortcutTaken: Another app is using this shortcut.
desktopApp.recordingHint: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift and press a key. Esc cancels.
desktopApp.shareActivityHint: Shows everyone here the game you're playing and what you're doing in it, for games that report it. Names and pictures come from Steam and the games' own files on this computer, or from a web address the game gives (a music player's album cover), which this computer downloads; a small copy of the picture goes to the server.

androidApp.lockScreenCallsOff: Android only shows incoming calls as a notification. Allow full-screen notifications for Voicaw to have calls ring over the lock screen.
androidApp.channelsHint: Messages, mentions, incoming calls, missed calls and the ongoing call are separate in Android's settings, each with its own sound and importance.
androidApp.pushLogHint: What this phone did with the last notifications the server sent it, to help find out why one didn't show.

reactionNotifications.dms: Only in DMs and group DMs
reactionNotifications.hint: For your whole account. In DMs and group DMs only the desktop and Android apps tell you: they're end-to-end encrypted, so only your device can see whether a reaction is a poll vote (votes never notify), and a browser would have to show a notification for each one.

notificationPrompt.needsInstall: To get notifications on this device, tap Share → "Add to Home Screen", then open Voicaw from your Home Screen.
notificationPrompt.offer: Get notified when you receive a message.

storage.title: Storage on this device
storage.total: Voicaw uses {{used}} on this device ({{free}} more available).
storage.totalUnknown: This browser doesn't say how much Voicaw uses on this device.

offlineCopy.label: Keep an offline copy
offlineCopy.hint: Direct messages, group chats and your notes you've opened are kept on this device, locked with a key that never leaves it, so you can read them when Voicaw can't be reached (without sending, and text only: no pictures or files). Turn this off and the copy is deleted. Saved on this device.

storage.persisted: This browser keeps Voicaw's storage even when space runs low.
storage.notPersisted: This browser may delete Voicaw's storage when space runs low (and Safari after 7 days without opening Voicaw, unless it's on your Home Screen). Nothing is lost on the server: your keys come back when you log in, and the copies fill again.
storage.logout: Logging out deletes both copies, and everything else Voicaw keeps here for your account.

notificationPreviews.label: Show message text in notifications
notificationPreviews.hint: Notifications for new messages show what was said. That's handy, but anyone who can see your screen, or your lock screen, can read it too. Turn this off and they only say who it's from (and where). The text of DMs and group DMs is only ever decrypted on this device; the Voicaw server never sees it. Saved on this device.

inviteEmbeds.label: Show guild invites in DMs and group DMs straight away
inviteEmbeds.hint: A guild invite link in a message gets a card with the guild's name and picture. To fill it in, the app asks the Voicaw server about the invite, which tells the server which invite was in your end-to-end encrypted message. Turn this off and the card waits until you tap Show. Guild channels aren't encrypted, so their invites always show. Saved on this device.

typing.label: Let others see when I'm typing
typing.hint: While you write a message, the others in the chat see that you're typing. In DMs and group DMs this tells the Voicaw server when you're typing and to whom, though never what. Turn it off and nobody sees you typing; you still see others. Saved on this device.

youtube.label: Show YouTube videos straight away
youtube.hint: A YouTube link in a message gets a player. Loading it tells YouTube your IP address and which video you were sent, even if you never play it. Turn this off and the player waits until you tap Play; nothing comes from YouTube before then. Saved on this device.

searchCopy.label: Keep a search copy on this device
searchCopy.hint: Only your devices can read direct messages, group chats and your notes, so they're searched here. The first search of a chat reads its whole history from the server; this keeps what it read on this device, locked with a key that never leaves it, so later searches only read what's new. Turn this off and the copy is deleted, and every search reads the whole history again. Logging out deletes it too. Saved on this device.

showLinkPreviews.label: Show link previews
showLinkPreviews.hint: A link to another site in a message gets a preview underneath: a card with the page's title, description and picture in guilds, a YouTube player, or the picture or video itself when the link goes straight to one. Turn this off and only the link shows, with nothing loaded from that site. Guild invites and events still get their cards, and bots' embeds still show. Saved on this device.

linkPreviews.label: Show pictures and videos from links straight away
linkPreviews.hint: A link in a message can show a preview: in guilds, the Voicaw server fetches the page and shows its title, description and picture; in any chat, a link straight to a picture or a video shows it. Pictures and videos load from the site they're on, which sees your IP address and what you were sent. Turn this off and each waits until you tap Show (or Play); a guild preview's text still shows, since it comes from the Voicaw server. Previews are never made for DMs and group DMs on the server, which never sees their links. Saved on this device.

gifs.label: Show GIFs straight away
gifs.hint: GIFs in messages, and the previews in the GIF picker, load from KLIPY, which sees your IP address and which GIFs you see (not the chat or its messages). Turn this off and each GIF waits until you tap Show, and the GIF picker asks before showing previews. Saved on this device.

safetyNumbers.label: Show safety numbers in DMs
safetyNumbers.hint: Each DM gets a Verified / Not verified button at the top that opens a 60-digit safety number. Compare it with the other person, in person or on a call: if both of you see the same number, nobody (not even the Voicaw server) has swapped in their own key to read your messages, and you can mark them verified. Your app checks keys either way and warns you if someone's key changes; this just lets you check for yourself. Saved on this device.

spellcheck.title: Spellcheck
spellcheck.hint: Misspelled words get a red underline. Right-click one for suggestions or to add it to your dictionary (Shift+right-click for the browser's own menu). Automatic picks from your browser's languages. Saved on this device.
spellcheck.hintNoLanguage: Misspelled words get a red underline. Right-click one for suggestions or to add it to your dictionary (Shift+right-click for the browser's own menu). Automatic picks from your browser's languages and found none of these, so your browser's (or the desktop app's) own spellcheck is used. Saved on this device.
spellcheck.noWords: No words yet. “Add to Dictionary” on a misspelled word puts it here.
spellcheck.wordsSynced: Your words follow your account to your other devices, end-to-end encrypted.

language.title: Language
language.label: Language
language.hint: The app reloads in the language you pick. Saved on this device. Messages aren't translated, and a few things (some errors from the server) may still be in English.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hintSystemDark: Your system is using dark mode now. Saved on this device only.
theme.hintSystemLight: Your system is using light mode now. Saved on this device only.

voice.title: Voice

echoCancellation.label: Echo cancellation
echoCancellation.hint: Stops others hearing themselves through your speakers.

autoGainControl.label: Automatic gain control
autoGainControl.hint: Evens out your volume when you move closer or further away.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: Removes background noise like fans, traffic and typing. Light on your device.

strong.label: Strong
strong.hint: Removes more, even while you talk, using more of your computer. A 17 MB download the first time.
strong.unavailable: Only on computers, in an up-to-date browser.
strong.tooSlow: This computer can't keep up with Strong, so Standard is being used instead.

browser.label: Your browser's
browser.hint: Good for steady noise like fans; lets typing through.

voice.micBlocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it to test.
voice.namesHidden: Your browser hides device names until Voicaw may use the microphone.
voice.micTestHint: Talk and you'll hear yourself back, as others hear you. Headphones help. While testing, you're muted and deafened.

autoSensitivity.label: Automatic
autoSensitivity.hint: Sends your voice only while you talk, so typing and clicks in between aren't heard.

voice.useLetsCheck: Use Let's check to see your level against it.
voice.cameraBlocked: Camera access is blocked. Allow it to test.
voice.cameraNamesHidden: Your browser hides camera names until Voicaw may use the camera. Test camera shows them.
voice.screenShareHint: How your screen goes out when you share it (you can change it each time you go live). Source is your screen's own size. Higher quality needs a faster upload, and the server sends every viewer the whole stream.

profile.tooLarge: That image is too large (max 8 MB).
profile.displayNameHint: Shown instead of your username ({{username}}). Leave it empty to use your username.

recoveryCode.title: Recovery code
recoveryCode.explanation: This is your recovery code. If you ever forget your password, it's the only way back into your account and your messages. Nobody else has a copy, not even the server, and it won't be shown again.
recoveryCode.keepItSafe: Save it in a password manager, or write it down and keep it somewhere safe.

recoveryPrompt.text: Set up a recovery code, so you can reset your password if you forget it.

blocked.title: Blocked Users
blocked.hint: People you have blocked can't message you, call you or add you to a group, and their messages are hidden for you. Blocked webhooks only have their messages hidden. Nobody is told.

authorisedApps.title: Authorised Apps
authorisedApps.hint: Websites you've logged in to with Voicaw. Each one can see your username, display name and profile picture until you remove it.
authorisedApps.none: You haven't logged in to any websites with Voicaw.

reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: What people have reported. Messages in DMs and groups are end-to-end encrypted: you only see one if the reporter chose to share it, and what they shared can't be checked.
reports.notShared: Encrypted, not shared by the reporter.
reports.suspendMessage: They're logged out everywhere and can't log in until the suspension is lifted. Their messages stay.
reports.reason: Reason (they see it when they try to log in; optional)

logOut.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to log out?

profileVisibility.title: Your profile
profileVisibility.hint: What others see in your profile's tabs. Your picture, names, banner, status and about me are always shown to everyone logged in.
profileVisibility.showActivityHint: The games you played in the last 30 days, with how long, from what the desktop app shares (Settings → Desktop App). Only the game's name and the times are kept, for 30 days. Turned off, nothing is recorded and what was kept is deleted.
profileVisibility.showMutualFriendsHint: The friends you have in common with whoever opens your profile.
